questions.prompt: The Berlin Airlift supplied which city during a Soviet blockade?
questions.fact: At its peak an aircraft landed roughly every thirty seconds, sustaining two million people for almost a year.

questions.prompt: Which blood type is the universal plasma donor?
questions.fact: It is the reverse of red cells: AB gives plasma to anyone, while O can receive plasma from anyone.

questions.prompt: Which sport features an event called the omnium?
questions.fact: It combines four separate races into one score, making it cycling's closest equivalent to a decathlon.

questions.prompt: Which streaming series dramatises the Chernobyl disaster?
questions.fact: It was filmed largely in Lithuania at a plant of the same Soviet design as the one that failed.

questions.prompt: Which country is directly south of Egypt?
questions.fact: It has more pyramids than Egypt, though they are smaller and far less visited.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Frankenstein's contemporary, Dracula?
questions.fact: It is told entirely through letters, diaries and newspaper clippings, with no conventional narrator at all.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a hash function in security?
questions.fact: It is deliberately one-way, which is why a stolen password database is not the same as stolen passwords.
